title: What Happens If You Accidentally Double-Hit the Ball?
question: If you accidentally hit the ball twice in one swing, how is this counted?

choices.text: It counts as two strokes and you receive a penalty
It counts as one stroke and there is no penalty
You must replay the shot from where you started
It is one stroke plus a one-shot penalty

explanation: If you accidentally double hit the ball in a single motion, it only counts as one stroke with no penalty.

juniorVersion.title: If You Accidentally Hit the Ball Twice in One Swing
juniorVersion.question: You swing your club and, by accident, hit the ball two times in one swing. What should you do?

choices.text: It counts as two shots and you get a penalty
It counts as one shot and there is no penalty
You have to take your shot again from the same spot
It is one shot plus a penalty

juniorVersion.explanation: If you hit the ball twice by mistake, but only swung once, it only counts as one shot. You do not get a penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: Sometimes, the club touches the ball two times in one swing. This is called a double hit.
A stroke is when you try to hit the golf ball with your club.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Let children practise swinging slowly so they understand how a double hit might happen, and that it's just counted as one shot if it was a single swing.
likelyMisconceptions: Kids might think a double hit always means extra shots added.
Some may think they must go back and replay the shot.
